out.draft:
Hi Ana,

You can set up quarterly maintenance visits for each customer in a few steps:

1. Open the customer's record.
2. Go to Service plans and click New plan.
3. Choose Quarterly as the interval and select the visit template you want to use.

Once the plan is saved, Fernhill creates the visits 30 days ahead of each scheduled date and places them on the dispatch board. They will be unassigned, so you can assign a technician to each one as needed.

Full steps are in our help article [KB-104] Set up recurring maintenance visits.

Let us know if you have any other questions.

Best regards,
Fernhill Support

out.draft:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the trouble. A crash when attaching photos blocks the job workflow, so we're treating it as a priority.

Please try these steps on both techs' phones:

1. Update the Fernhill tech app to the latest version in the App Store. Photo crashes are often fixed in app updates.
2. Check that the app has Camera and Photos (storage) permission. On iPhone, go to Settings > Fernhill > and turn on both. See [KB-105] for details.

If the app still closes after updating and checking permissions, reply with the app version each tech is running and whether the crash happens with every photo or only certain ones. That will help our engineering team reproduce it. In the meantime, the techs can keep working offline, since the app saves jobs locally and syncs once it reconnects.

I'll follow up on this ticket once I hear back from you.

Best,
Fernhill Support

Hi Grace,

I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing, especially with your accountant having to clean up about 40 duplicate invoices. I've escalated this to our engineering team as a high-priority sync issue, and I'll update you as soon as I have a timeline.

In the meantime, please try the steps in our QuickBooks guide [KB-102]:
1. Go to Settings > Integrations > QuickBooks Online and disconnect the integration.
2. Reconnect it by clicking Connect.
3. Turn on 'Match by invoice number.'

If duplicates continue after that, please reply with two example invoice numbers that were duplicated. That will help our engineers trace the cause quickly.

You can also check live service status at status.fernhill.example for any ongoing incident that may be related.

Thank you for your patience,
Fernhill Support
